## Dossier: Encounter (backend — `care`)

### FHIR R5 alignment

CARE's `Encounter` closely tracks the FHIR R5 [Encounter](https://build.fhir.org/encounter.html) resource, encoded via a Django model ([care/emr/models/encounter.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/models/encounter.py)) and Pydantic resource specs ([care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py)).

| FHIR R5 element | CARE implementation | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `status` field, `StatusChoices` enum | Values match FHIR's encounter-status value set exactly (using `entered_in_error` for `entered-in-error`) |
| `class` (0..*) | `encounter_class` (single value), `ClassChoices` | FHIR allows multiple classes over time; CARE stores only current + a JSON history (`encounter_class_history`), not a list |
| `priority` | `priority`, `EncounterPriorityChoices` | Maps to ActPriority-style codes |
| `subject` (Patient) | `patient` FK → `Patient` | [spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py) L16 |
| `serviceProvider`/facility context | `facility` FK → `Facility` (PROTECT) | No direct FHIR `Organization`-as-serviceProvider field name, but conceptually equivalent |
| Encounter departments/orgs | `EncounterOrganization` join table → `FacilityOrganization` | Approximates FHIR's `Encounter.careTeam`/organization linkage; cached in `facility_organization_cache` for authz |
| `location` (backbone, 0..*, with `status`) | `FacilityLocationEncounter` model + `Encounter.current_location` cache | See Data model section |
| `participant` | `care_team` JSONField (`user_id` + `role` Coding) | Role bound to a value set (SNOMED-based), not a FHIR `Practitioner`/`PractitionerRole` resource reference |
| `appointment` | `appointment` FK → `TokenBooking` | CARE's own booking model, not FHIR `Appointment` resource directly |
| `period` (start/end) | `period` JSON (`PeriodSpec`: `start`, `end`) | [base.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/base.py) L181 — both datetimes must be timezone-aware |
| `admission` (admitSource, reAdmission, dietPreference, dischargeDisposition) | `hospitalization` JSON (`HospitalizationSpec`) | Field names/semantics match FHIR R5's `Encounter.admission` backbone almost 1:1 |
| `identifier` | `external_identifier` (plain string) | No FHIR `Identifier` type/system structure, just a bare string |
| `diagnosis` | Not present on Encounter spec/model | Likely modeled via a separate `Condition` resource; link **not verified** in this pass — see Ambiguities |
| `EncounterHistory` (FHIR R5 introduced this as a separate resource for status/class history) | `status_history` / `encounter_class_history` JSON fields on the same `Encounter` row | CARE does not use a separate FHIR-style `EncounterHistory` resource — history is inlined |
| Extensions | `extensions` JSONField, validated via CARE's own `ExtensionValidator`/`ExtensionResource.encounter` plugin mechanism | [extensions/base.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/extensions/base.py) — a CARE-specific plugin extension system, not a literal FHIR `extension` element implementation |

Related linked FHIR-ish resources seen in code: `Patient` (Patient), `Facility`/`FacilityOrganization` (Organization), `FacilityLocation`/`FacilityLocationEncounter` (Location), `TokenBooking` (Appointment), `User` (Practitioner, via care team).

---

### Data model

Model: [care/emr/models/encounter.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/models/encounter.py). Spec: [care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py).

| Attribute | Type | Required (create) | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `StatusChoices` | Yes | — | |
| `encounter_class` | `ClassChoices` | Yes | — | |
| `priority` | `EncounterPriorityChoices` | Yes | — | |
| `period` | `PeriodSpec {start, end}` | No | `{}` | Datetimes must be tz-aware |
| `hospitalization` | `HospitalizationSpec` | No | `{}` | See below |
| `external_identifier` | `str \| None` | No | `None` | Free-text hospital reference number |
| `discharge_summary_advice` | `str \| None` | No | `None` | Cleared to `None` on update if omitted (see Business rules) |
| `patient` | UUID (create-only) | Yes | — | Resolved to `Patient` FK; excluded from update spec |
| `facility` | UUID (create-only) | Yes | — | Resolved to `Facility` FK (PROTECT) |
| `organizations` | `list[UUID]` (create-only) | No | `[]` | Deduplicated; becomes `EncounterOrganization` rows |
| `appointment` | UUID (create-only) | No | `None` | Must belong to same patient/facility; encounter can't be created if the booking already has an associated encounter |
| `care_team` | JSON (not in create/update spec — separate endpoint) | No | `{}` | Managed via `set_care_team_members` action only |
| `current_location` | FK → `FacilityLocation` | — (system-managed) | `None` | Cached pointer to the active location |
| `facility_organization_cache` | `ArrayField[int]` | — | `[]` | Cache of org IDs for authorization queries |
| `care_team_users` | `ArrayField[int]` | — | `[]` | Cache of care team user IDs for filtering/authz |
| `tags` | `ArrayField[int]` | — | `[]` | Managed via tag `set_tags`/`remove_tags` actions |
| `extensions` | JSON | — | `{}` | Plugin/extension payloads |
| `status_history` / `encounter_class_history` | JSON | — | `{}` | Append-only log of `{status, moved_at}` on every change |

**Hospitalization** ([spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py) L44-48):

| Field | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `re_admission` | `bool \| None` | No | `None` |
| `admit_source` | `AdmitSourcesChoices \| None` | No | `None` |
| `discharge_disposition` | `DischargeDispositionChoices \| None` | No | `None` |
| `diet_preference` | `DietPreferenceChoices \| None` | No | `None` |

No backend field named "discharge date/time" exists separately — discharge timing is expected to be represented via `period.end` (unverified explicitly; see Ambiguities).

---

### Enums and coded values

All from [care/emr/resources/encounter/constants.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/constants.py) unless noted.

**Status (`StatusChoices`)**: `planned`, `in_progress`, `on_hold`, `discharged`, `completed`, `cancelled`, `discontinued`, `entered_in_error`, `unknown`

- `COMPLETED_CHOICES = [completed, cancelled, entered_in_error, discontinued]` — these lock the encounter from further non-clinical edits and clinical-data submission. **`discharged` is NOT in `COMPLETED_CHOICES`** — a discharged encounter remains editable (see Suspected Code Issues).
- `ERROR_CHOICES = [entered_in_error]` — blocks writing new service requests only.
- No status state-machine/transition-graph validation exists in the backend (no "planned → in_progress → …" enforcement found anywhere in [encounter.py viewset](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/encounter.py) or [spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/spec.py)). Any status value can be set to any other via update, as long as the current status isn't in `COMPLETED_CHOICES`.

**Encounter Class (`ClassChoices`)**: `imp`, `amb`, `obsenc`, `emer`, `vr`, `hh`

**Priority (`EncounterPriorityChoices`)**: `ASAP`, `callback_results`, `callback_for_scheduling`, `elective`, `emergency`, `preop`, `as_needed`, `routine`, `rush_reporting`, `stat`, `timing_critical`, `use_as_directed`, `urgent`

**Admit Source (`AdmitSourcesChoices`)**: `hosp_trans`, `emd`, `outp`, `born`, `gp`, `mp`, `nursing`, `psych`, `rehab`, `other` — backend display labels in [enum_display_names.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/enum_display_names.py)

**Discharge Disposition (`DischargeDispositionChoices`)**: `home`, `alt_home`, `other_hcf`, `hosp`, `long`, `aadvice`, `exp`, `psy`, `rehab`, `snf`, `oth`

**Diet Preference (`DietPreferenceChoices`)**: `vegetarian`, `dairy_free`, `nut_free`, `gluten_free`, `vegan`, `halal`, `kosher`, `none`

**Re-admission**: plain boolean, not an enum.

**Location status (`LocationEncounterAvailabilityStatusChoices`, [location/spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/location/spec.py))**: `planned`, `active`, `reserved`, `completed`
- `active` must not carry an `end_datetime` (forced to `None`).
- `completed` requires an `end_datetime`.
- Once a `FacilityLocationEncounter` reaches `completed`, its status can never change again (`"Cannot change status after marking completed"`, [location.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/location.py) L~416).

**Care team participant role**: not a fixed enum — a `Coding` bound to the `PRACTITIONER_ROLE_VALUESET` ([valueset.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/encounter/valueset.py)), backed by SNOMED CT concepts under `223366009` and `224930009` ("Healthcare related organization role" / etc.). No fixed hardcoded list — it's a queryable value set.

**Tag category (`TagCategoryChoices`)**, [tag/config_spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/tag/config_spec.py): `diet`, `drug`, `lab`, `admin`, `contact`, `clinical`, `behavioral`, `research`, `advance_directive`, `safety` (applies to all taggable resources, encounter included). `TagStatus`: `active`, `archived`.

---

### Business rules and validations

Source: [care/emr/api/viewsets/encounter.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/encounter.py), [care/emr/api/viewsets/location.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/location.py), [care/emr/api/viewsets/device.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/device.py), [care/emr/tagging/base.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/tagging/base.py).

**Creation** (`validate_data`, L127-143):
- Patient must have fewer than `MAX_ACTIVE_ENCOUNTERS_PER_PATIENT_IN_FACILITY` (default 5) non-completed encounters at that facility, else: *"Patient already has maximum number of active encounters (N) in the facility"*.
- Patient and Facility must exist (else "Patient does not exist" / "Facility does not exist").
- If an `appointment` is supplied and it already has an associated encounter: *"Encounter already has an associated booking"*.
- `status_history`/`encounter_class_history` are seeded with the initial status/class + timestamp on creation.

**Update**:
- Any status/class change appends to the respective history JSON.
- If `discharge_summary_advice` is omitted (None) on update, it is explicitly cleared.
- Encounters with status in `COMPLETED_CHOICES` (completed, cancelled, entered_in_error, discontinued) cannot be updated at all — `can_update_encounter_obj` returns `False` before checking permissions.
- On every successful update: any device with `current_encounter` pointing here is disassociated **if** the new status is in `COMPLETED_CHOICES` ([device.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/device.py) `disassociate_device_from_encounter`), and any non-completed `FacilityLocationEncounter` rows are force-closed (status → `completed`, `end_datetime` = now) and the location's `current_encounter`/`operational_status` reset ([location.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/location.py) `close_related_location_from_encounter`).
- **No backend validation requires `discharge_disposition` to be set when status becomes `discharged`.** This appears to be enforced (if at all) only on the frontend — see Suspected Code Issues.

**Restart** (`POST .../restart`):
- Only allowed if current status is in `COMPLETED_CHOICES` (so **not** allowed from `discharged`), else *"Encounter is not in a completed state"*.
- Blocked if `modified_date` is older than `ENCOUNTER_RESTART_TIME_LIMIT_HOURS` (default **0**) hours ago: *"Encounter cannot be restarted after N hours"*. With the default of 0 hours, this check effectively always fails (see Suspected Code Issues).
- On success: status is forced to `in_progress` (bypassing normal update pathway/history append logic).

**Location association** (`FacilityLocationEncounterViewSet`, [location.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/api/viewsets/location.py)):
- Cannot assign an encounter to a location whose `mode` is `kind` (only `instance`-mode locations, e.g., actual beds, not location categories): *"Cannot assign encounters to location kind"*.
- `end_datetime` must be ≥ `start_datetime`: *"End Datetime should be greater than Start Datetime"*.

### What an Encounter is, for the reader
An Encounter records one interaction between a patient and the facility — an outpatient visit, an admission, an observation stay, an emergency visit, a virtual consultation, or a home visit. Permission "Update Encounter non clinical" — Administrator, Doctor, Nurse and Facility Administrator. You also need permission to see the facility's locations.

### Before you start
The encounter exists and is still open. The facility has locations set up, and the bed or room you want belongs to the same facility as the encounter.

### Entry points
- On the encounter page, open **Encounter Actions** (shortcut `Shift+E`) and select **Assign Location**.
- Or press `l` on the encounter page.
- Or, on the **Overview** tab side panel, select **Update Location**.

### The location sheet
The sheet has two tabs: **Assign** and **History**.

**Assign a location**
1. Browse the facility's locations and select the bed or room the patient occupies. You can only assign a real place, such as a bed or a room. You cannot assign a location category.
2. Set the state of the stay. A stay can be planned, reserved or active. Only one stay can be active at a time.
3. Set the start time, and the end time when the stay has one.
4. Confirm.

**Move the patient to another location**
1. Select the new bed or room and choose the move action.
2. Care asks whether to keep the previous bed reserved for the patient, or to free it. Choose one.
3. Confirm.

**When the bed is taken**
- If an open encounter already occupies the bed, Care blocks the assignment and tells you the bed is occupied. You cannot override this. Free that bed first.
- If the encounter that occupies the bed is discharged, Care asks you to confirm before it moves the new patient in.

**History tab**
The History tab lists the patient's earlier stays for this encounter. From it you can correct the times of a stay, close a stay, or cancel a stay. Care asks you to confirm before it removes a stay.

### Rules Care applies
- The end time must be the same as or later than the start time. Otherwise Care shows "End Datetime should be greater than Start Datetime".
- A closed stay needs an end time. Otherwise Care shows "End Datetime is required for completed status".
- After you close a stay, you cannot change its state again.
- Two stays cannot overlap at the same location. Care shows "Conflict in schedule".
- The location and the encounter must belong to the same facility.
- While a patient occupies a bed, Care shows the bed as reserved. When the stay closes, Care shows the bed as available again.
- When you set the encounter status to Completed, Cancelled, Discontinued or Entered in error, Care closes any open stay for you.
- A discharged encounter still holds its location. Care only frees the bed when the stay closes or when someone marks the encounter as complete.

### Vocabulary
Care groups locations as Site, Building, Wing, Ward, Level, Corridor, Room, Bed, Vehicle, House, Cabinet, Road, Area, Jurisdiction and Virtual.

### Note
A user who belongs to the department that owns the patient's current bed can open the encounter, even when that user does not belong to the encounter's own departments.

Care's Encounter follows the FHIR R5 Encounter resource (https://build.fhir.org/encounter.html). Link it on first mention.
Care implements: status, class, priority, subject (the patient), the facility that provides the service, location, participant (as the care team), appointment, period (start and end), and the admission details (admit source, re-admission, diet preference, discharge disposition). Care records one encounter class at a time and keeps a history of every status change and class change on the encounter itself, instead of a separate FHIR EncounterHistory resource. Care stores a single free-text hospital identifier rather than the structured FHIR identifier. Care's Encounter has no diagnosis element.
Related resources an Encounter links to: Patient, Organization (the facility and its departments), Location (the bed or room), and Appointment (the booking the encounter started from).

### What an Encounter is, for the reader
An Encounter records one interaction between a patient and the facility — an outpatient visit, an admission, an observation stay, an emergency visit, a virtual consultation, or a home visit. It groups everything the care team records for that interaction. A patient can have several encounters at a facility at the same time; the deployment sets the maximum (5 unless the deployment changes it).

### Key attributes (use these user-facing labels)
- Status
- Type of Encounter (called Encounter Class on the update form)
- Priority
- Date and Time (the start), and Discharge Date and Time (the end)
- Hospital Identifier — a free-text reference number the facility uses, such as an IP, OP, OBS or EMR number
- Departments — at least one is required, and they control who can see the encounter
- Care team — the staff who look after the patient, each with a clinical role, and one marked as primary
- Current location — the bed, room or ward the patient occupies
- Tags — labels the facility configures
- Hospitalization details — Re-admission, Admit Source, Discharge Disposition, Diet Preference. These appear only for Inpatient, Observation and Emergency encounters.
- Discharge Summary Advice — free text, available once the patient is discharged

Care applies no rules about which status can follow which. Any status can move to any other status while the encounter is still open.

- Ambulatory — Patient visits for outpatient care

Home, Alternate home, Other health care facility, Hospice, Long term care, Left against advice, Expired, Psychiatric hospital, Rehabilitation, Skilled nursing facility, Other.

Vegetarian, Dairy free, Nut free, Gluten free, Vegan, Halal, Kosher, None.

## Definition An **[encounter](https://build.fhir.org/encounter.html)** in Care is a single interaction between a patient and your facility.
